messages:
Priya CSM: Quick thread — building Meridian QBR deck. Need: crisp onboarding status, 1-slide renewal concern, and an ask we can present to execs. Please review slides 1-5 draft and call out blockers.
Mike CSM: I'll drop onboarding metrics (activation %, tasks open). We have 78% activated, 5 high-priority tasks, 2 blocked on customer data. Will add timeline.
Javier AE: Exec ask options: (A) 6-month price protection, (B) 10% credits toward load testing, (C) Dedicated capacity pilot. Which do we prefer? I recommend B + C combo.
Leah Eng: Demo reliability note: long-context requests sometimes hit 2.2s lat spikes during hours 11-13 PST. Suggest demo fallback to short-context model + canned message. I can document steps.
Tom PM: Can we include an enablement workshop invite (90 minutes) in QBR? that'll reduce churn risk. We should propose dates.
Priya CSM: Yes 12 include a slide: 'Enablement: Proposed workshop + objectives'
Mike CSM: Need a customer quote for renewal slide; last CS call: "If we can't rely on the stack during peak, renewal will be hard."  permission to anonymize? @Priya CSM
Priya CSM: You have permission, use: "reliability during peak is our #1 concern"
Leah Eng: Paste fallback snippet:
``
Demo fallback:
1) If p95 latency > 1.2s for 5s window, route to `model-lite` endpoint
2) Use prefix: /demo/meridian/short
3) If response length < 30 tokens, send canned: "Demo fallback active 12 reconnecting"
4) Log: post to #eng-oncall with trace id
```
Javier AE: Good. Also, on renewal ask, let's list expected ROI bullets so execs see value.
Priya CSM: Action owners draft:
- Onboarding metrics (slide 2)  Mike CSM  today EOD
- Renewal slide & quote  Javier AE  tomorrow 10am
- Demo fallback doc + appendix  Leah Eng  tomorrow noon
- Enablement workshop slide + dates  Tom PM  tomorrow 3pm
- Final deck assembly  Priya CSM  day after 11am
review-bot: Reminder: QBR review slot booked 2024-05-15 16:00 PT. Invite: Priya CSM, Mike CSM, Javier AE, Leah Eng, Tom PM
infra-bot: Created ticket INF-7123 to provision demo-lite endpoint. ETA 1d. Link: https://redwood.company/INF-7123
Mike CSM: Noted blockers: waiting on customer to upload test dataset (CS-Ticket #887). If that doesn't arrive, demo will use synthetic data.
Priya CSM: I'll follow up with the customer contact today. Also collecting 3 short customer wins to put on slide 1  drop any you have here.
Javier AE: Win: reduced inference cost 26% after batching changes.
Leah Eng: Win: demo latency improved after cache tuning for short contexts.
Tom PM: Win: rollout of auto-retry reduced timeouts on peak by 40%.
Priya CSM: Perfect. If no objections, I'll assemble and post deck by review-bot deadline. Thanks all. :celebrate:
